questions.stem: Marko purchased a camera in September 2017 when the camera had a value of \$1{,}000. Each month for the next 50 months, the value of the camera decreased by 3% of the previous month's value. Which equation represents this situation, where $v$ is the value of the camera, in dollars, $m$ is the number of months since Marko purchased the camera, and $m\le50$?

A sum of $\$9{,}000$ was invested in a certificate of deposit (CD) that earns interest, and no other deposits or withdrawals were made after that. The function $f(x)=9{,}000(1+0.03)^x$ gives the value of the CD, in dollars, $x$ years after the investment was initially made, where $x\le 5$. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the statement \"$f(2)$ is approximately equal to $9{,}474.08$\" in this context?

options.A: The value of the CD would be approximately $9{,}474.08$ dollars if invested at $2\%$ interest.
options.B: $9{,}474.08$ days after the investment was made, the value of the CD was approximately $2$ times greater than its initial value.
options.C: $2$ years after the investment was made, the value of the CD was approximately $9{,}474.08$ dollars.
options.D: $2$ years after the investment was made, the value of the CD was approximately $9{,}474.08$ dollars greater than its initial value.

A snack company advertises that bags of pretzels produced by the company weigh, on average, $1$ pound each. To test this, Sam selected at random $40$ bags of pretzels produced by the company and weighed each bag. Based on his measurements, Sam estimated that for all bags of pretzels produced by the company, the average weight per bag is $1.05$ pounds, with a margin of error of $0.06$ pounds. For all bags of pretzels produced by the company, which of the following is the most appropriate conclusion about the average weight $w$, in pounds, per bag?

A market researcher collected data on the price of an iced coffee at $42$ locations selected at random in a state.

The mean price of an iced coffee in the state was estimated to be $\$1.37$, with an associated margin of error of $\$0.05$. Which of the following is a plausible statement about the mean price of an iced coffee for all locations that sell this product in the state?

options.B: It is either less than $\$1.32$ or greater than $\$1.42$.
